sentences.text: Sillanpään Saaristo & Rannikkopalvelut Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-03 under the industry code 81300, landscape service activities.
First sales are recorded on 2026-09-01, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-09-14.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has archipelago and coastal words but the registered industry is landscape services.
